summary: DT Dijkstra designs and makes washing, sorting, transport and bunker installations for potatoes and other tuber and bulb crops. It is based in Emmeloord, Netherlands, where it has its offices and factory. The website gives no founding year and describes the company's experience as "over 90 years".
machines: Screen sorting machine: sorts washed and unwashed potatoes to size, with quick-change screens
RT 2/5 sorter: size grading with frequency-controlled shaking and hydraulic screen clamping
TT2/6 sorter: size grading, supplied in a potato reception line
Drum washer: wet cleaning, with stone and clod separator
Dry soil removers: spiral, star and smooth-roller types plus hedgehog belt, remove adhering soil
Pre-soak tank, floating-parts separator and polisher: wet cleaning stages
Felt-based dryer: dries product before packing
Crate tipper and crate filler: empty and fill crates
Conveyor belts, weighing belts and drop breakers: product handling and transport
Bunkers and bunker overhaul kit: storage, with soft foam and rubber layer to reduce bruising
markets: References in the Netherlands, Turkey, Canada, Spain, Slovenia, Hungary and Germany
facts: Turkey reception line handed over in May 2024 with 16 storage bunkers holding 700 tonnes of potatoes
Stular (Slovenia): sorting line 35 tonnes per hour, washing installation 30 tonnes per hour
Schaap Holland bunker overhaul: total bunker capacity of 1,500 tons
Seed potato sorting line for a 50 ha seed potato farm at Maatschap Geerligs, Anna Paulowna

contact.address: DT Dijkstra, Landbouwkade 6, 8304 AE Emmeloord, Netherlands

limitations: The website does not publish a legal entity name, founding year, owners, staff numbers or revenue.
Capacities in tonnes per hour are not published for the sorting machines, washers or handling equipment in the model range.
Most project pages do not name the customer or give throughput.
